cd /tmp && curl -s --max-time 60 http://192.168.111.101:40114/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer dummy' \
  -H 'X-SMG-Routing-Key: dsh-verify-debugflip-001' \
  -D /tmp/smg-headers.txt \
  -d '{"model":"/models/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"say OK"}],"max_tokens":8,"stream":false}' \
  -o /tmp/smg-body.json -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"
echo "=== response headers of interest ==="
grep -i "smg\|worker" /tmp/smg-headers.txt
echo "=== body ==="
head -c 400 /tmp/smg-body.json; echo

cd /tmp && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request

url = "http://192.168.111.101:40114/v1/chat/completions"
payload = json.dumps({
    "model": "/models/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "say OK"}],
    "max_tokens": 8,
    "stream": False,
}).encode()

req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=payload, method="POST")
req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer dummy")
req.add_header("X-SMG-Routing-Key", "dsh-verify-debugflip-001")

try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=90) as r:
        print("HTTP", r.status)
        for k, v in r.getheaders():
            if "smg" in k.lower() or "worker" in k.lower():
                print(f"  {k}: {v}")
        body = r.read().decode()
        print("body:", body[:300])
except Exception as e:
    print("ERROR:", type(e).__name__, e)
PY
